outcome: Efficacy of misoprostol for induction of labor
cohort: 337 pregnant women with singleton pregnancy and cephalic presentation admitted for induction of labor at MTI, Lady Reading Hospital (LRH), Peshawar, Pakistan between January 21st and December 31st, 2021
finding: Misoprostol is a safe and effective medication for induction of labor, leading to good fetomaternal outcomes.
mod_finding: The majority of women (85.1%) delivered spontaneously with misoprostol induction, while 10.68% delivered by cesarean section.
